verification.note: Clean rebuild of the #201-300 Rated Rookie block from a full Checklist Insider extraction supplied directly by the user on 2026-09-03, replacing the earlier optic-chase-manifest.csv-derived mapping (see data/football/2024/_staging/optic.json, kept as historical/research evidence, NOT the basis for this file). Every record starts at VERIFIED_ONE_SOURCE (source1 = Checklist Insider). A record is upgraded to VERIFIED_TWO_SOURCE only when a genuinely independent second source (e.g. Beckett) confirms that exact card-number/player/team identity - not merely the #201-300 Rated Rookie range, which Beckett independently establishes but which is not itself per-card proof. See data/checklists/football/2024/optic-v2-verification-report.md for the per-record breakdown and data/checklists/football/2024/optic-v1-v2-diff.csv for the full comparison against the prior (now-superseded) staged mapping.
requiresForLive: As many records as possible upgraded from VERIFIED_ONE_SOURCE to VERIFIED_TWO_SOURCE via a genuinely independent second source
Remaining VERIFIED_ONE_SOURCE / CONFLICT / NEEDS_REVIEW records explicitly reviewed and accepted under a documented standard (none has been approved yet)
Addition to CHECKLIST_MANIFEST['football|2024'] only after the above, and only with explicit approval
verification.integrityNote: IMPORTANT: the TCDB extraction supplied for this reconciliation is byte-for-byte identical (same 100 rows, same order, same exact name/team formatting including quirks like 'AJ Barner' and em-dash separators) to the Checklist Insider extraction used to build this v2 file's source1 data. A genuinely independent second pull from a different database would be expected to show at least minor formatting or ordering differences even where the underlying facts agree. This 100/100 match is mechanically correct per the comparison rule requested, but should NOT be read as strong independent confirmation - it is equally consistent with both 'sources' tracing back to the same underlying extraction. Flagged for human review before this is treated as satisfying the two-source requirement for CHECKLIST_MANIFEST promotion.
verification.provenanceNote: Two distinct verification tiers now tracked per record: BECKETT_INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED (Checklist Insider + a genuinely independent Beckett confirmation - counts toward the launch gate) vs TCDB_MECHANICAL_MATCH_INDEPENDENCE_UNCONFIRMED (the TCDB extraction matched 100/100 but its independence from source1 could not be established, so it does NOT count toward the launch gate). Only BECKETT_INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED records satisfy the two-source requirement.
